comment: §9.4 case set for the explain-brief prompt + brief-guard. kind:'model' cases call the deployed prompt verbatim and assert the raw rewrite (style, number subset, guard verdict). kind:'guard' cases are offline and deterministic. Regression rule: a case that passes may never fail after a prompt, guard, or model change; every defect seen in the wild is added here as a new case before it is fixed.
